tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background of both apps.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, chat bubbles, menus — on ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel edges. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and button outlines; focus ring base. 3:1 on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and phosphor-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, metadata — on ground or surface.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: The brand: primary actions, active nav, focus ring, live/streaming state; as text on ground, surface or phosphor-soft.

tokens.name: phosphor-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind phosphor or ink text: selected rows, the user's own chat bubble, active tab.

tokens.name: on-phosphor
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a phosphor fill (primary button).

tokens.name: signal-cyan
tokens.usage: Async and system work: queued jobs, Kafka events, info notes; as text on ground or surface.

tokens.name: signal-amber
tokens.usage: Needs a human: approval pending, tier-limited notice, warnings; as text on ground or surface.

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: Denied, failed, error, dead-letter; as text on ground or surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — alias of phosphor.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; the base grid unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (horizontal), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels only.
